entries.toelichting: Hithpalpel: tarry (Gen 19:16; 43:10; Ex 12:39; Judg 3:26; 19:8; 2Sam 15:28; Ps 119:60; Hab 2:3). Hyphenated.
Eunuch of Ahasuerus (Esth 1:10). English convention: Mehuman.
Edomite queen and Nehemiah's prophet-grandfather (Gen 36:39; 1Chr 1:50; Neh 6:10). English convention: Mehetabel.
Gen 19:29; Deut 29:23; Isa 1:7; 13:19; Jer 49:18; 50:40; Lam 4:6; Amos 4:11. Standard concordant.
David's mighty man (2Sam 23:28; 1Chr 11:30; 27:13). English convention: Maharai.
Qal/Ni/Pol/Hithpal: melt-away, dissolve (Ex 15:15; Josh 2:9,24; 1Sam 14:16; Job 30:22; Ps 46:6; 65:10; 75:3; 107:26; Isa 14:31; 64:7; Jer 49:23; Eze 21:15; Amos 9:5,13; Nah 1:5; 2:6). Hyphenated.
Qal/Ni/Pol/Hithpolel: cut-around, circumcise (Gen 17:10-27; 21:4; 34:15,17,22,24; Ex 4:26; 12:44,48; Lev 12:3; Deut 30:6; Josh 5:2-8; Jer 4:4; 9:25; Ps 58:7; 90:6; 118:10,11,12). Standard concordant.
Negev town (Josh 15:26; 19:2; 1Chr 4:28; Neh 11:26). English convention: Moladah.

Set-time, festival, meeting-place, congregation (~223 occurrences across Torah, Joshua-2Kings, Chronicles, Psalms, Prophets — covers fixed cultic-feasts, prophetic-times, and the 'tent-of-meeting' ohel-moed). Hyphenated.
Reubenite town (Josh 13:18; 21:37; 1Chr 6:79; Jer 48:21). English convention: Mephaath.
Benjamite town and Saulide (Josh 18:26; 1Chr 8:36,37; 9:42,43). English convention: Mozah.
Ni/Hi: change, alter (Lev 27:10,33; Ps 15:4; 46:2; 106:20; Jer 2:11; Eze 48:14; Hos 4:7; Mic 2:4). Standard concordant.
Reverent fear (Gen 9:2; Deut 4:34; 11:25; 26:8; 34:12; Ps 9:20; 76:11 (?); Mal 1:6; 2:5). Hyphenated.
Joel 2:23; Ps 84:6; Isa 30:20; Job 36:22; Prov 5:13. Hyphenated dual aspect.
Oak/hill (Gen 12:6; Deut 11:30; Judg 7:1). English convention: Moreh.
Mountain of Abraham's testing and the temple-mount (Gen 22:2; 2Chr 3:1). English convention: Moriah. 'YHWH-provides'.
Town near Gath (Mic 1:14). Hyphenated. English convention: Moresheth-gath.
Gentilic of Moresheth (Jer 26:18; Mic 1:1). English convention: Morashtite.

Qal/Hi: remove, withdraw (Ex 13:22; 33:11; Num 14:44; Josh 1:8; Judg 6:18; Job 23:12; Ps 55:11; Prov 17:13; Isa 22:25; 54:10; 59:21; Jer 17:8; 31:36; Mic 2:3,4; Nah 3:1; Zech 3:9; 14:4 (?)). Standard concordant.
Qal/Pi/Hi/Hophal: die, kill, put-to-death (~836 occurrences spanning all OT — the standard verb of dying and putting-to-death). Standard concordant 'die'.
Sung-praise, psalm-title (57 of Psalms 3-150). Standard concordant.
Qal/Pi: applaud, smite-hand (Ps 98:8; Isa 55:12; Eze 25:6). Hyphenated.
David's mighty man (1Chr 11:46). English convention: Mahavite.
Father of wise-men (1Kgs 4:31). English convention: Mahol.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:52; Neh 7:54). English convention: Mehida.
Gen 45:5; Lev 13:10,24; Judg 6:4; 17:10; 2Chr 14:13; Ezr 9:8,9. Standard concordant.
Daughter of Zelophehad (Num 26:33; 27:1; 36:11; Josh 17:3; 1Chr 7:18). English convention: Mahlah.
Son of Naomi (Ruth 1:2,5; 4:9,10). English convention: Mahlon.
Wife of Esau and granddaughter of David (Gen 28:9; 2Chr 11:18). English convention: Mahalath.
Inhabitant of Abel-meholah (1Sam 18:19; 2Sam 21:8). English convention: Meholathite.
Camp, encampment, host (~219 occurrences spanning all OT — military and tribal encampments, especially the wilderness-camp of Israel). Standard concordant 'camp'.
Camp of Dan (Judg 13:25; 18:12). Hyphenated. English convention: Mahaneh-dan.
Place east of Jordan (Gen 32:2; Josh 13:26,30; 21:38; 2Sam 2:8,12,29; 17:24,27; 19:32; 1Kgs 2:8; 4:14; 1Chr 6:80; Song 6:13). English convention: Mahanaim. 'Two-camps'.
Father of Neriah (Jer 32:12; 51:59). English convention: Mahseiah.
Qal: smite-through (Num 24:8,17; Deut 32:39; 33:11; Judg 5:26; 2Sam 22:39; Job 5:18; 26:12; Ps 18:38; 68:21,23; 110:5,6; Hab 3:13). Standard concordant.
Gen 43:23; Job 3:21; Prov 2:4; Isa 45:3; Jer 41:8. Hyphenated.
Qal/Ni/Hi: send rain (Gen 2:5; 7:4; 19:24; Ex 9:18,23; 16:4; Job 20:23; 38:26; Ps 11:6; 78:24,27; Isa 5:6; Eze 22:24; 38:22; Amos 4:7). Standard concordant.
Interrogative pronoun 'who?' (~423 occurrences spanning all OT). Standard concordant.
Moabite city (Num 21:30; Josh 13:9,16; 1Chr 19:7; Isa 15:2). English convention: Medeba.
Danite border-water (Josh 19:46). Hyphenated. English convention: Me-jarkon.
Edomite queen's grandfather (Gen 36:39; 1Chr 1:50). Hyphenated. English convention: Me-zahab.
Levite and others (2Sam 9:12; Neh 10:11; 11:17,22). English convention: Micha.

Multiple persons including the chief-prince-archangel (Num 13:13; 1Chr 5:13,14; 6:40; 7:3; 8:16; 12:20; 27:18; 2Chr 21:2; Ezr 8:8; Dan 10:13,21; 12:1). English convention: Michael. 'Who-is-like-Mighty-One'.
Prophet and Levite (Judg 17:1-13; 18:2-31; 2Sam 9:12; 1Chr 5:5; 8:34,35; 9:15,40,41; 23:20; 24:24,25; 2Chr 18:14; 34:20; Jer 26:18; Mic 1:1). English convention: Micah. 'Who-is-like-YH'.
Multiple persons (2Chr 13:2; Neh 12:35; Jer 36:11,13). English convention: Michaiah.
Prince sent by Jehoshaphat to teach (2Chr 17:7). Hyphenated.
David's wife, Saul's daughter (1Sam 14:49; 18:20-28; 19:11-17; 25:44; 2Sam 3:13,14; 6:16-23; 21:8; 1Chr 15:29). English convention: Michal.
Water, body of water — extremely frequent (~580 occurrences spanning all OT). Standard concordant 'water'.
Priests (1Chr 24:9; Ezr 10:25; Neh 10:7; 12:5,17,41). English convention: Mijamin.
Daniel's friend Meshach and others (Ex 6:22; Lev 10:4; Neh 8:4; Dan 1:6,7,11,19; 2:17). English convention: Mishael. 'Who-is-what-Mighty-One-is'.
